title: Keep annotation tag deletes scoped without forcing a zero tag ID
answers: Removed annotation tags still appear in tag filtering
Why does ensureTags fail to unlink replaced tags?
How should MustCols be used when deleting annotation tag links?
body:
Symptom: Tags removed from an annotation still appear in annotation tag filtering.
Root cause: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:ensureTags forced the delete bean's zero TagID into the WHERE clause, adding tag_id = 0 alongside tag_id IN (...).
Fix pattern: Force only annotation_id with MustCols; let In("tag_id", tagsDelete) supply the tag predicate.
Constraints: Applies to link deletion in ensureTags, shared by Add, update and AddMany. Keep annotation_id forced even when zero, or the delete can affect other annotations; this does not repair existing stale links or the separate AddMany write-back defect.
applies: Changes to annotation tag link deletion in xormRepositoryImpl.ensureTags.
